items.html:
(to the question) Unclean blood
Within the MAN of ZA that ascended for pregnancy to AVI are included all the Partzufim below it, and after all that belongs to ZA is clarified, the rest comes out in the secret of the blood of birth, as above in answer 29. However, even from the phase of ZA not all the phases are clarified, for of the phase of the coarseness of Hod, only the phase of the root of this coarseness is clarified, and the rest of the phases are clarified afterward by means of the milk; and likewise Yesod and Malchut, which are drawn from Hod.
